name: T3 Code
description: Minimal web GUI for coding agents (Codex, Claude and others).

web.cmd: U=${HOMEMADE_URL/#https:\/\/$HOMEMADE_PROJECT-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME-/https://$HOMEMADE_PROJECT-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME-5733-}; echo "T3 Code pairing link: $U/pair#token=$(cat ~/.t3-share/token)" | tee ~/t3-pairing-link.txt; cd apps/web && T3CODE_PORT=13773 T3CODE_SINGLE_ORIGIN_DEV=1 T3CODE_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS=.onhmmd.com,.onhomemade.com exec pnpm exec vp dev --host 0.0.0.0
